text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Ever since that day, I threw myself into my work with even greater dedication.
I even put real effort into searching for a trainee, something I had thought was too early for me.
choice_data_list: (But the one I can't stop thinking about is...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Holy Maiden who had awakened me.
It was Red Desire.
choice_data_list: (Her running is incredible after all!)
(Her running really is amazing!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even more than that, I was captivated by her unbreakable resolve.
She had saved me. This time, I wanted to be the one to support her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I have the strength to support an Umamusume... Now, I can believe that.
However, she seems to have everything already...
choice_data_list: (What could I possibly do for her?)
(What can I possibly do for her?)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh!
choice_data_list: Ah! Are you okay...?!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer...
It seems I may have pushed myself too far.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
However, have no fear. The sacred flame within my heart burns fiercely.
Come, I must overcome today's trial as well...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*...! *wheeze*...!
I'm finally at the halfway mark... Just 500 more reps...!
choice_data_list: 500?! Isn't that way too much...?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Without pushing oneself to the absolute brink of suffering, muscle hypertrophy cannot be achieved.
This, too, is a trial... Please, worry not.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: After all, I am a Saint!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe this is where the real issue lies.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
It is only beyond arduous trials that the Otherworld awaits.
For that sake, I can endure any hardship.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
In fact, the greater the agony, the closer I feel to the Otherworld!
This throbbing in my chest...! Ahh! Everything before my eyes is turning pure white...♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her passion was so intense she couldn't reign it in.
If so, what she truly needed was a Trainer who could act as her brake... right?
choice_data_list: Sometimes restraint is important, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I carefully and thoroughly explained that "high-load muscle training during growth periods is actually detrimental to physical conditioning."
choice_data_list: Restraint itself might be a trial.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I see... In the long run, by exercising restraint,
the power of the Saint shall ascend to even greater heights...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
O, enlightened one.
Would you be willing to teach me more?
choice_data_list: G-Gladly!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
—*pant*, *pant*, *pant*, *pant*...
My body feels strangely light this morning...?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(I see... yesterday's fatigue hasn't lingered at all.
I was so accustomed to trials that I didn't even notice...)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I can feel holy power coursing through my entire being...
Restraint itself is a trial... huh.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahーーーーーーーーーっ!!

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
Red Desire, you've been in great shape lately! That's a new record!
Looks like your training efficiency really improved.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl F
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~, Desire-chan is amazing too~!
Looks like Buena-chan isn't the only standout on the Tiara route...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I simply unleashed all the restrained holy power at once.
This is my true power...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What Red Desire needs is a brake.
With that, she will undoubtedly shine brighter than ever...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want to become her Trainer and support her, no matter what.
I know I can do it now. I can scout her with my head held high.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Still, I wanted one final push to make her truly thrilled to sign with me... As I browsed a bookstore pondering this—
choice_data_list: “The Galloping Saint's Isekai Reincarnation”...? That's it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later...
I devised a plan at a spot Red Desire frequented.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Oh my? Could this be... an Ore of the Sacred Flame?!
It's just like the one in the novel...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
The Saint is guided by the ore to the 'Sanctuary of Heavenly Light'...
A holy place around here would be... Gasp! The 'Church of the Three Goddesses'?!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *gasp*............!
Who calls upon me?!
choice_data_list: O, Holy Maiden!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All I wanted was to touch her heart. With that singular devotion, I reenacted a scene straight out of the novel.
It's okay, this will work. Because...!
choice_data_list: I am the one awakened by the power of the Saint!
I am the one awakened by the power of the Saint!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...Ah! By... my power...?!
choice_data_list: O Saint, what is your dream?
O Saint, what is your dream?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: To reach the Otherworld, of course!
choice_data_list: Please, let me help you realize that wish...!
Please, let me help you realize that wish...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Saying that, I stepped out from the shadows.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Ah...! It was you after all, wasn't it...?!
choice_data_list: Form a contract with me. I want to make your dream come true.
Form a contract with me. I want to make your dream come true.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...! To make my dream come true...?
Not to make me stronger, or simply to win?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I know not where the Otherworld lies,
nor how many trials must be overcome to reach it.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Even so, you would strive toward it alongside me?
choice_data_list: I'll do everything in my power.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I didn't know if a fantastical 'Otherworld' really existed.
However, I told her that I would support her to the utmost so she could achieve her dream.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I didn't know if a fantastical 'Otherworld' really existed.
However, I told her that I would support her to the utmost so she could achieve her dream.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
What an honest soul...
Yet, that very sincerity is proof enough.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
It matters not. The existence of the Otherworld is something only a Saint can feel.
...Your true devotion is more than enough.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter how impossible the dream, she would believe in it.
I was reminded once again of just how precious such unwavering passion is.
choice_data_list: (Seeing you like that is what saved me...)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
The distant Otherworld... I shall not ask you to "journey there together."
When that time comes, please send me off with your blessings.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
In any case, we have but one thing to do.
Let us overcome our trials together and gather our brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I shall run endlessly to the ends of the earth!
Please, watch over and support this devoted Saint.
choice_data_list: You bet!
Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Where she would end up beyond the finish line was anyone's guess.
All I could do was support her as a racehorse girl.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
You truly are worthy of accompanying the Saint.
Come, let us forge our sacred contract—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so... the journey of the self-proclaimed Saint, Red Desire,
and a Trainer who had reclaimed their dream began—!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Even so... to think you loved isekai reincarnation novels as well!
Fufu, preparing such a splendid stage for me...♪
choice_data_list: Well, about that...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had only crammed and studied frantically just to make her happy...
I'll keep that a secret!
